entries.title: Psalms 89:1
segments: ¶<<An instruction. Of Ethan the Ezrahite.>> I will sing of the loving-kindness of Jehovah for ever; with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness from generation to generation.

entries.title: Psalms 89:2
segments: For I said, Loving-kindness shall be built up for ever; in the very heavens wilt thou establish thy faithfulness.

entries.title: Psalms 89:3
segments: I have made a covenant with mine elect, I have sworn unto David my servant:

entries.title: Psalms 89:4
segments: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne from generation to generation. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:5
segments: ¶And the heavens shall celebrate thy wonders, O Jehovah, and thy faithfulness in the congregation of the saints.

entries.title: Psalms 89:6
segments: For who in the heaven can be compared to Jehovah? [who] among the sons of the mighty shall be likened to Jehovah?

entries.title: Psalms 89:7
segments: *God is greatly to be feared in the council of the saints, and terrible for all that are round about him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:8
segments: Jehovah, God of hosts, who is like unto thee, the strong Jah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.

entries.title: Psalms 89:9
segments: *Thou* rulest the pride of the sea: when its waves arise, *thou* stillest them.

entries.title: Psalms 89:10
segments: Thou hast crushed Rahab as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.

entries.title: Psalms 89:11
segments: Thine are the heavens, the earth also is thine; the world and its fulness, *thou* hast founded them.

entries.title: Psalms 89:12
segments: The north and the south, *thou* hast created them: Tabor and Hermon triumph in thy name.

entries.title: Psalms 89:13
segments: Thine is the arm of might: strong is thy hand, high is thy right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 89:14
segments: Righteousness and judgment are the foundation of thy throne; loving-kindness and truth go before thy face.

entries.title: Psalms 89:15
segments: ¶Blessed is the people that know the shout of joy: they walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 89:16
segments: In thy name are they joyful all the day, and in thy righteousness are they exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:17
segments: For thou art the glory of their strength; and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:18
segments: For Jehovah is our shield, and the Holy One of Israel, our king.

entries.title: Psalms 89:19
segments: ¶Then thou spakest in vision of thy Holy One, and saidst, I have laid help upon a mighty one; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

entries.title: Psalms 89:20
segments: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

entries.title: Psalms 89:21
segments: With whom my hand shall be established; and mine arm shall strengthen him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:22
segments: No enemy shall exact upon him, nor the son of wickedness afflict him;

entries.title: Psalms 89:23
segments: But I will beat down his adversaries before his face, and will smite them that hate him.

entries.title: Psalms 89:24
segments: And my faithfulness and my loving-kindness shall be with him, and by my name shall his horn be exalted.

entries.title: Psalms 89:25
segments: And I will set his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 89:26
segments: *He* shall call unto me, Thou art my father, my *God, and the rock of my salvation;

entries.title: Psalms 89:27
segments: And as to me, I will make him firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 89:28
segments: My loving-kindness will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him;

entries.title: Psalms 89:29
segments: And I will establish his seed for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 89:30
segments: If his sons forsake my law, and walk not in mine ordinances;

entries.title: Psalms 89:31
segments: If they profane my statutes, and keep not my commandments:

entries.title: Psalms 89:32
segments: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

entries.title: Psalms 89:33
segments: Nevertheless my loving-kindness will I not utterly take from him, nor belie my faithfulness;

entries.title: Psalms 89:34
segments: My covenant will I not profane, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

entries.title: Psalms 89:35
segments: Once have I sworn by my holiness; I will not lie unto David:

entries.title: Psalms 89:36
segments: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me;

entries.title: Psalms 89:37
segments: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and the witness in the sky is firm. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:38
segments: ¶But thou hast rejected and cast off; thou hast been very wroth with thine anointed:

entries.title: Psalms 89:39
segments: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant; thou hast profaned his crown to the ground:

entries.title: Psalms 89:40
segments: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.

entries.title: Psalms 89:41
segments: All that pass by the way plunder him; he is become a reproach to his neighbours.

entries.title: Psalms 89:42
segments: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his oppressors; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice:

entries.title: Psalms 89:43
segments: Yea, thou hast turned back the edge of his sword, and hast not made him stand in the battle.

entries.title: Psalms 89:44
segments: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground;

entries.title: Psalms 89:45
segments: The days of his youth hast thou shortened; thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:46
segments: How long, Jehovah, wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy fury burn like fire?

entries.title: Psalms 89:47
segments: Remember, as regards me, what life is. Wherefore hast thou created all the children of men to be vanity?

entries.title: Psalms 89:48
segments: What man liveth, and shall not see death? Shall he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 89:49
segments: Where, Lord, are thy former loving-kindnesses, [which] thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?

entries.title: Psalms 89:50
segments: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants--that I bear in my bosom [that of] all the mighty peoples--

entries.title: Psalms 89:51
segments: Wherewith thine enemies, O Jehovah, have reproached, wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 89:52
segments: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore! Amen, and Amen.
